facts.title: high potential incident during routine operation on B-8202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HOT_SURFACE_GUARDING: the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces on B-8202, D-8210 and PSV-8202 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in protecting people from hot surfaces, specifically insulating, guarding and signing hot surfaces. B-8202 (package boilers and deaerator) is in service for process steam generation and feedwater deaeration. The task proceeded during routine operation while the insulation, guarding and signing of hot surfaces had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 24 February 2026 a high potential incident was recorded on B-8202, D-8210 and PSV-8202 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station during routine operation; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
